array.string: set -uo pipefail; D="$HOME/Library/Caches/nuke-market-live-finish-runner"; mkdir -p "$D"; git fetch -q origin main || exit 1; git show origin/main:scripts/market/live-finish.mjs > "$D/live-finish.mjs" && git show origin/main:scripts/market/live-finish.py > "$D/live-finish.py" && git show origin/main:scripts/market/live-finish-coverage.json > "$D/live-finish-coverage.json" || exit 1; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) $(git rev-parse --short origin/main)"; dotenvx run -q -- node "$D/live-finish.mjs"; s32=$?; if git show origin/main:scripts/market/live-finish-33.py > "$D/live-finish-33.py"; then dotenvx run -q -- python3 "$D/live-finish-33.py"; s33=$?; [ "$s33" -eq 0 ] || echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) model 33 exited $s33 (model 32 exited $s32)"; else echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) model 33 runner not on main; skipped"; fi; exit $s32
